name: Astoria Pastry Shop (Royal Oak)
summary: The Royal Oak location of Astoria Pastry Shop, the Greektown bakery established by the Teftis family in 1971. Same pastry counter and specialty coffee, open 8am to 11pm every day.
customCakeProcess: The shop asks that pickup orders be set for a time at least 48 hours from when the order is placed.
